children: Zcash ETF entered into the Sixth Amendment to the Master Custody Service Agreement with Anchorage Digital, adding it as an additional custodian for a portion of the trust’s ZEC. Coinbase Custody remains the primary custodian, and the sponsor will determine allocations between custodians. Anchorage will safeguard private keys in U.S.-based hardware security modules and, upon instruction, may withdraw ZEC to cover the sponsor’s fee and expenses per existing procedures. The move supports the sponsor’s risk management approach as the trust grows.
